data.body: **[P2] Do not skip a replay-marked completion that is still pending.** A completion received through `onOperationChange` can later reach `onOperationEnd` with `isReplay: true` because updated IDs are fixed at invocation start. This defers export until cleanup; after a containing child context closes, the invocation view parents the continuation to `Invocation` instead of that child. Treat pending IDs as unexported first observations and update `InvocationOtelPlugin` to create their continuation despite the replay flag. Add an invocation-view assertion covering the continuation's child parent.
